rationale: The supplement is exactly one Page file; its before hash equals P003 r3 shared Page after hash, after_text hashes to its declared after hash. CI verification now asserts that singleton Page path, preserving exact domain/lesson hashes rather than broadening their allowance.

Before updating answer state, the handler captures the active item enclosing formula testid only under an exact W048 display contract. After one animation frame it verifies the same connected article/ref and W048 class, reselects only that formula row and resets its horizontal offset. It does not enumerate or reset other formula rows. Re-selection also tolerates formula DOM replacement within the same flow.

The contract requires N13 unitId with revision5 or N14 unitId with revision11 and matching exported contract identity/revision. Old revisions and other units receive no target testid and no scheduled formula scroll reset. N14 current revision10 remains excluded; future r11 dynamic testing is still required.

Existing onReviewAnswer/answerTextbook arguments and ordering remain intact; no grading, choices, answer persistence, archive, migration, reset or lesson data is edited by the supplement. This is adequate as display/save design; actual post-application save and wrong/correct action regressions remain R07 obligations.

I authored a bounded post-application CODE probe and reviewed CI guard changes, not the Page supplement or lesson layout. This authorship is disclosed and probe execution is delegated to M; its results cannot replace nonauthor semantic or visual review.
